method: Read the publisher documents and compare them with the prior findings, affected skills and available retained bodies. Compare two fresh observations for each proposed pin. Content hashes identify the exact representation. Historical body availability limits any claim about differences. The unchanged 22 sources keep their prior review dates.

records.finding: The ADK index covers graph-based agents, evaluation and deployment across language toolchains. The ADK profile already asks for the language, installed package and runtime before selecting an API.
Google distinguishes an agent's identity from the end user's identity. Keep scoped credentials and independent checks at the tool boundary in the tool review.
ADK separates session events and state from durable or retrieved memory. The memory review already traces persistence, ownership and service lifetime independently.
The portable plugin specification defines package contents and path containment. Host permissions and process isolation still require separate checks in the authoring and security workflows.
The skill specification requires a name and description and supports optional resource folders. The catalog validator checks frontmatter and the generated packs keep references beside SKILL.md.

Google's managed agents guide still describes preview status, tool billing and unrestricted default outbound access with configurable restrictions. The evaluation and security reviews should continue to record egress and tool use explicitly.

The model page now presents several model choices, including Carbon, Neon and Hydrogen. The evaluation guide and ADK profile require the actual model and settings for a run, so neither needs a default model change.
NIST's resource center describes a voluntary framework and its evaluation resources. The evaluation and extraction reviews use case-specific evidence and make no NIST certification claim.
Airflow can retry a task. Repeatable interval inputs and deliberate handling of external effects remain applicable to the data pipeline review.

With no explicit agentMode, agy print mode from 1.5.7 can select auto where available. Actions requiring unavailable approval can still be denied with exit zero. Record the selected mode when comparing runs and inspect the action result.

Google documents native plugin validation and separate build and publication steps. The CLI accepts the four local pack directories. It rejects the preview marketplace entries without a source URL. Document the directory install as the supported path.

Antigravity documents discovery by description and direct slash selection. Neither establishes an enforceable explicit-only control for these native packs. Keep the 17 explicit-only workflows excluded.
Terraform describes declarative configuration, modules and providers. The stack profile discovers local version requirements, provider locks and the repository's approved commands.
The Agents CLI article covers local development, evaluation and deployment. A working scaffold still provides no evidence that the user authorized cloud resource creation or publication.
Google describes the Gemini CLI transition and differences in feature coverage and migration routes. Keep authentication, host support and installed-client evidence specific to each client.
OpenAI describes instruction priority, context and examples. The prompt review uses those principles and separately verifies the target model and permission to act.

BigQuery explains projection, partition filtering and query plans. LIMIT on a query that reads every column does not establish a smaller scan. The warehouse review already checks both projection and filters.
The Data Agent Kit lists coding-agent integrations and different database authentication options. Derive accessible data from the actual identity and connection in tool and retrieval reviews.
Dataflow distinguishes committed outputs from retried execution. External side effects and late data still need explicit handling in the data pipeline review.
Dataform documents incremental filtering, unique-key merges, schema handling and assertions. The data profile checks those settings and the conditions each assertion proves.
Google organizes the enterprise platform around building, scaling, governing and optimizing agents. A listed platform service does not establish an application's memory lifetime or authorization.
The Managed Spark image index distinguishes component versions, support windows and unsupported images. Review the image actually configured for a job before interpreting Spark behavior.
Cloud Storage assigns separate generation and metageneration values. Compare metadata only for the same object generation when reviewing retries or conditional writes.

The HTML and publisher Markdown cover incremental filters, unique keys, predicates, full refresh and schema changes, including adapter constraints. The Markdown produced identical bytes twice. Bind freshness to the complete Markdown, keeping the human-facing article link.
Spring Boot now lists 4.2.0 among its stable releases. The Java profile discovers the project's BOM, build system and JDK before applying release-specific guidance.

The Swift documentation JSON contains topic identifiers for language, package and tooling material. Pair it with the rendered site's identity and inspect the actual project toolchain for compatibility.
The Swift documentation landing response is an application shell. Its separate topic JSON supplies a content check. A shell fingerprint alone cannot establish SDK behavior.
Adobe separates cloud AEM, 6.5 and 6.5 LTS in its documentation. The stack review chooses guidance after identifying the deployed product generation.
OWASP describes cross-tenant leakage and contamination of vector retrieval. The retrieval review checks authorization before retrieval, isolation and source integrity.

OWASP's initiative page identifies a collection of agent security resources. Its resource listings can change independently of the local security review, which asks for system-specific evidence. Comparison of the differing retrieved JSON bodies identified permutations of taxonomy classes in resource-card markup. The endpoint-specific marker orders runs of category, tag and learning-persona class names. It retains their membership, resource links, article text and other response bytes.
Git documents merge ancestry, unfinished merges and the risks to uncommitted changes. The conflict-resolution workflow first identifies the operation and preserves existing work.
Git documents shared repository data and per-worktree state. Isolation and branch cleanup still require checking other worktrees, ownership and active operations.

The Codex subagent guide distinguishes role instructions and supported overrides from inherited permissions, provider and MCP configuration. The coordination workflow keeps delegation within the parent's authority.
The .NET index groups SDKs, target platforms, migration and tooling. The stack profile uses the project's SDK selection and target frameworks before choosing checks.
Next.js distinguishes optimistic route checks from authorization near data access and mutations. The cache and auth review traces shared static output and the actual read or write boundary.

The Next.js 16 upgrade guide describes coding-agent assistance, codemod coverage and cache API choices. The planning reference already checks local versions, manual migration gaps and validation commands.
OpenTelemetry defines signals and their relationship to observed activity. The observability skill uses that vocabulary and defines monitoring around user-visible failure and operator action.

Anthropic's model-specific guidance changes thinking and context advice while retaining clarity, context and examples. Prompt authoring and review keep provider-specific options tied to the target model.

React describes deriving values during render, using event handlers where appropriate and measuring production performance. The rendering review keeps these checks grounded in the observed interaction.
SLSA v1.2 distinguishes build provenance from source provenance. The dependency review checks what the attestation identifies and what evidence the verifier can actually validate.
Salesforce separates SOQL, DML and the platform's data-access model. The Apex review still requires checking execution context and limits before running an org-backed operation.
The Drupal development index covers several toolchains and development environments. The PHP profile discovers the installed core generation, Composer constraints and local test setup.

The PostgreSQL 18 EXPLAIN page distinguishes estimates from measured execution. EXPLAIN ANALYZE runs the statement. The query-plan review already accounts for external effects that a rollback cannot undo.
The current PostgreSQL manual now identifies 19.0. The stack profile continues to discover the actual server version and uses the separate PostgreSQL 18 EXPLAIN reference for version-specific advice.
Swift Evolution distinguishes proposals and release goals from shipped behavior. The Swift reviews require the compiler version and active language or concurrency settings.
The TypeScript documentation separates language behavior, module resolution and configuration. The JavaScript and TypeScript profile inspects the installed compiler, tsconfig and lockfile.

WCAG 2.2.2 has separate conditions for moving content and auto-updating content, with exceptions for essential activity. The motion review keeps that Level A rule distinct from interaction-triggered animation.
